objective: Calibrate source-allele sets without knowing each read's literal error count; measure catalogue and noise shift separately. Does not certify observed-base ancestry.
selection: 512 previously unused isolated chr20 indels, same 2024 draft benchmark and BED as MP27; exclude MP09/MP22/MP25/MP27 positions; SHA256 rank MP28_LOCUS_SPLIT_V1|position, first 256 calibration and next 256 test; no outcome-dependent selection or quotas
noise_semantics: At each source position independent insertion and deletion Bernoulli draws; one inserted base when present; substitution Bernoulli only for nondeleted base. Recorded edits count literal operations. Uncalibrated controlled simulation, not a fitted sequencing model.
nuisance: Deterministic SNP at event_start-25, SNP at event_end+25, and insertion GCA immediately before event_end+40. SNP follows A->C->G->T->A. Same construction for each source allele. Nuisance background is a source haplotype, not sequencing noise.
crop: Source event starts at 300. Center start=300-floor((150-event_length)/2); left_event_absent start=301; right_event_absent stop=event_end-1. Every source crop is 150 nt. Labels are generating source allele even when target event is not fully observed.
blocks: 12 records per locus and regime: 2 alleles x 3 geometries x 2 replicates. Block nonconformity is max true-allele score across all 12. 6144 calibration records and 9216 test records; each row used for every declared applicable comparison.

candidate_catalogues.canonical: reference and target-alt sequences with 300nt reference context each side
candidate_catalogues.expanded: canonical plus nuisance versions of each allele; four templates; same allele labels

score: Minimum unit-edit cost over all positive-length source crops in templates for each allele. Cap32; beyond-cap is infinity; no truncation into an apparently finite score.
quantile: Rank ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) in the n calibration locus-block maxima; rank>n or censored order statistic gives infinity and both labels.
coverage_boundary: Standard split-conformal coverage is marginal over exchangeable locus blocks with fixed score and matched generation regime. The fixed chr20 panel is a controlled empirical evaluation, not proof of exchangeability, per-locus conditional coverage, biological calibration or robustness to arbitrary distribution shift.
freeze: Save calibration thresholds and hashes before starting test scoring. No tuning to test outputs. Preserve every adverse result.
reporting: Raw block and record denominators, whole-block coverage, record coverage, correct singleton, wrong singleton, ambiguous two-label sets and empty sets, by comparison/alpha and geometry/indel stratum. Both alpha values reported, no winner selection.
invariants: Expanded catalogue score <= canonical score; fixed-threshold canonical set subset of expanded set. For baseline/shifted true source in canonical, true-allele score <= literal edit count when within cap; for nuisance true source in expanded same invariant. No soundness claim for mismatched catalogues.
runtime: CPU up to4 workers; checkpoint per locus; soft stop9.5h; copy exact protocol/source-bound checkpoints on resume. Kaggle completed-run output persistence plus verified GitHub custody.
integration: User authorized reintegration with principal line; retain historical P1 and MP27 results and private manuscript originals; publish scientific code/results only after verification. This campaign is controlled simulation, not additional wet-lab evidence.
source: Angelopoulos and Bates, arXiv:2107.07511, split-conformal quantile construction
